summary: QScale is one active Canadian AI/HPC data-center platform legally held through Fonds QScale S.E.C. Goldman Sachs Alternatives closed a control acquisition on May 13, 2026 as the first investment of West Street Infrastructure Partners V; founders and management retained minority equity, while Aligned, Investissement Québec and Desjardins Capital exited. Create one platform record and exclude Q01 buildings and campus SPVs.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The Goldman acquisition SPV, price and exact percentages for Goldman and founder-management are not publicly disclosed.
The identities and 2026 disposition of unnamed investors that supplied C$45mm of 2021 equity are unresolved.
Additional campus-subsidiary names and commissioned IT load are not publicly disclosed.
